requirements:
This system represents a car. 
Cars belong to models, which in turn belong to makes. Each car has four wheels, one engine and a set of seats. Every make and model have a unique name. Each wheel has a diameter, which must be the same for all wheels of the same car. Each engine has a certain power. Likewise, the seats have a size, which must be the same for all the seats of the cars of the same model.Each car has a number plate that identifies it.

classes.name: Car
classes.description: Represents an individual vehicle with four wheels, one engine and a set of seats.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Represents an engine in a car. All engines of the same model have the same power.

classes.name: Make
classes.description: Represents a manufacturer of cars, which includes all models with the same name and engine power.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: Represents a specific type of car, which includes all cars with the same make and engine power.

classes.name: Seat
classes.description: Represents a seat in a car. All seats of the same model have the same size.

classes.name: Wheel
classes.description: Represents a wheel on the car. All wheels of the same car have the same diameter.
